chapter_mission: Let Ben tell Kael the whole truth, give Kael space to choose, and close the chapter with the trio finally assembled.
chapter_turn: The plan stops being Ben's proposal and becomes something the group is actually willing to do.

scene_plan.purpose: Ben gives Kael the full plan, the full risk, and no sales pitch.
Kael needs a stretch of real solitude in which no one follows him.
His return and line should complete the team without softening who he is.

relationship_turns.to: invitation accepted — Kael's commitment is the thematic spine of the book answered. Ben has led by asking; Kael has answered by choosing. The Gavran pattern is not the only pattern available

model and pupil — Desh did not know he was showing Kael anything; Kael sees in him a version of freedom he has never inhabited. No scene between them in this chapter; the relationship lands across distance
divergent choice — Veraine reached the same ridge and chose destruction; Kael reaches it and chooses participation. The parallel resolves without Veraine on-page

exit_vector: The group moving down the valley slope in formation. Desh split off toward the first amplification node. Sera, Ben, Kael abreast. Three Force presences adjacent, not yet harmonised. Torin a figure on the far ridgeline descending toward the Scar. Veraine's ritual's distortion visible at the base. The clock at minutes.
notes: This chapter is about consent and trust. Ben's honesty matters more than certainty, and Kael's decision matters because he is free to walk away.
